what: Photutorial states Adobe Stock's content library is many times larger than Envato's for images (300M+ vs 90M+) and videos (25M+ vs 5M+), but Envato Elements has more music, SFX, templates, 3D, and fonts.
verbatim_snippet: "Adobe Stock and Envato Elements are very similar in the content they offer. Both have images, videos, music, templates, 3D, and fonts, while Envato also has SFX and themes. However, Adobe Stock's content library is many times larger than Envato's. For example, they have 300+ million images to Envato's 90+ million and 25+ million videos to Envato's 5+ million. However, Envato Elements has more music files, SFX, templates, 3D and fonts. This makes it easier to find good images and videos at Adobe Stock, but easier to find the rest at Envato."
notes: Page blocked by robots.txt on direct fetch. Text captured from Google search result snippet attributed to this URL. Photutorial discloses partnership with Envato Elements ("our partnership with Envato Elements can give you 10% off"). Affiliate coupon codes present for both platforms.
